output.summary: The orders-api v3.8.0 deploy introduced a TypeError in PriceFormatter.format and the 5xx rate crossed the threshold right after the rollout. The incident was detected in 2 min and resolved with a human-approved rollback to v3.7.2; MTTR was 11.2 min, of which 3 min were spent awaiting approval.
output.rootCauseNarrative: Version v3.8.0 reads the currency field of prices with no currency set, which caused 380 TypeError occurrences only in that version. Rolling back to the previous stable version removed the defect and the canary confirmed the recovery.
prevention: Promote versions with a gradual rollout and an automatic canary.
